rows.checker:
import sys, re
path = sys.argv[1]
try:
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)
required = ['## 自动做实验', '## 自动写作与审稿', '## 自动选题', '## 结论']
for h in required:
    if h not in text:
        sys.exit(1)
# 检查每个路线标题下至少有一个非空段落（非标题行）
for h in required[:3]:
    start = text.index(h) + len(h)
    rest = text[start:]
    next_h = re.search(r'\n## ', rest)
    section = rest[:next_h.start()] if next_h else rest
    lines = [l.strip() for l in section.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith('#')]
    if not lines:
        sys.exit(1)
# 检查结论部分有明确选择
concl_start = text.index('## 结论') + len('## 结论')
concl = text[concl_start:]
if not re.search(r'(押|推荐)', concl):
    sys.exit(1)
# 结论中必须提到三条路线之一（自动做实验/自动写作与审稿/自动选题）
if not any(r in concl for r in ['自动做实验', '自动写作与审稿', '自动选题']):
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
